backup.production_rule: verified_at is the backup creation time. Additive only: nine new nullable columns on guest_profile_details, save_guest_profile_v1 redefined with the same signature to accept the new patch keys. No data touched, no column renamed or dropped. Apply within one hour of the backup or take a new one.

forward_verification.name: nine_new_columns_exist
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 9 from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'public' and table_name = 'guest_profile_details' and column_name in ('contact_number','birthday','address','airbnb_profile_id','id_on_file','id_type','id_number','id_drive_url','id_verified_at')

forward_verification.name: save_guest_profile_v1_same_signature
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname = 'save_guest_profile_v1' and pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) = 'p_guest_id uuid, p_patch jsonb, p_expected_version integer, p_reason text'

forward_verification.name: anon_cannot_call_save_guest_profile
forward_verification.query: select not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.save_guest_profile_v1(uuid, jsonb, integer, text)', 'execute')

forward_verification.name: id_on_file_defaults_false
forward_verification.query: select column_default = 'false' from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'public' and table_name = 'guest_profile_details' and column_name = 'id_on_file'

rollback.safe_until: any guest_profile_details row has a non-null value in one of the nine new columns; after that clear or migrate that data out first
